overview_description.description: Right Farm is a UAE-based agritech and B2B food supply-chain company that uses technology and data-driven logistics to connect farms directly with restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens, retailers, and foodservice businesses. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Dubai, the company focuses on making fresh produce sourcing simpler, faster, and more sustainable across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region.
